title: docs(spec): a form section's translation TSDoc names both addresses — objects.OBJECT._sections for an object form view, metadataForms for a metadata form
body:
Fixes #23756

Clause-②: no

## What changed

These are TSDoc and comment edits only, at the three locations the card and comment `6205162974` name, plus a fourth docblock the seat's review found (item 4). No `.describe()` text, schema or code changes. Measured at base `74b436263`.

1. **`packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, `FormSectionSchema.name`.** The TSDoc named one address, `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME`. It now names both addresses and which form each one serves:
   - **Object-bound form view:** `objects.OBJECT._sections.NAME`. OBJECT is the form's own `data.object`, else its view's. The i18n extractor (`walkObjectSections`) scaffolds the key, the translation linter (`collectViewRecord`) accepts it, and `translateView` serves it. A section without a `name` has no key and keeps its authored text.
   - **Metadata-editing form** (`defineForm({ schemaId })`): `metadataForms.TYPE.sections.NAME`, read by `resolveMetadataFormLabels`. A nameless section is looked up there under a slug of its `label`.

   The group-key comment on the same schema (the `:3862` site) also named `metadataForms.…` as the anchor. A section's `group` points at an object's `fieldGroups`, so its key is `deriveFieldGroupLayout`'s `key` at `objects.OBJECT._sections.KEY`, as `field-group-layout.ts` declares. The comment now says that.
2. **`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, `_sections`.** The TSDoc named `record:details` as the only reader. It now names:
   - the three authoring surfaces that put a name under this key: form-view `sections[].name`, `record:details` `sections[].name`, and object `fieldGroups[].key`;
   - the three readers on `main`: `walkObjectSections`, which scaffolds the key from all three; `collectViewRecord`, which accepts a form view's names; and `translateView`, which overlays a served form view's `config.sections`;
   - the `description` leaf, which the schema already declares;
   - the metadata-form address, which is a different key.
3. **`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `translateFormSections`.** The docblock said "Three rules, each the one its sibling translators already follow". It now says that rules 1 (own `name` key) and 3 (a diverged string beats the catalog) are shared with `translateBulkActionDefs`, and that rule 2 (only authored copy is translated) belongs to sections alone. `resolveViewDescription` returns a catalog description the view never authored, and `translateBulkActionDefs` has no authored-copy guard.

4. **`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`, `resolveMetadataFormLabels`** (patch round, head `e7ac53b9a1`). The docblock said a section without a stable `name` keeps its section-level text, which contradicted item 1's new text and the function's own `translateSection`. It now says what the code does: the lookup key is the section's `name`, else a slug of its string `label` (lowercased, `&` → `and`, each run of non-alphanumerics → `_`, edge underscores trimmed). Only a section with neither keeps its section-level text, and its fields are translated either way. The changeset gained one sentence for it.

Every reader named above was found by its function name on `main` at `74b436263`:
- `walkObjectSections`: `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:914`
- `collectViewRecord`: `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts:484`
- `translateView` and `translateFormSections`: `i18n-resolver.ts`
- `resolveMetadataFormLabels`: `i18n-resolver.ts:3926`
- `defineForm`: `view.zod.ts:7145`

The card body also lists objectui's form renderers as a reader. This repo does not contain them, so the new text does not name them as a reader.

## Changeset: `patch`, not `skip-changeset`

The dispatch hypothesis was that comments do not publish. That was measured false for this diff:
- `@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` includes `src/**/*.zod.ts` and `dist`.
- After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, the new `view.zod.ts` text ("one of two addresses, decided by what the form edits") and the new `translation.zod.ts` text ("Three authoring surfaces name a section under this key") both appear in `dist/**` bundles. The `i18n-resolver.ts` text appears only in `src`.
- Positive control: unchanged TSDoc from the same docblock is also present in `dist/**`.

So the diff publishes text, and `.changeset/23756-section-translation-tsdoc.md` is a `patch` for `@objectstack/spec`. The `skip-changeset` label is not applied.

## Generated artifacts

None carry this text. `git grep` for each replaced sentence returns zero hits after the edit. `check:docs` ran green against the rebuilt `dist`.
